text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ......Heheheh.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...'Kiseki' 'Race'
'Japan Cup' 'Front-runner'...?"

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
“I've rewatched Kiseki's Japan Cup video 30 times”
“She's the strongest active Umamusume” “Terrifying front-runner”
“Her past races are hype too~! Did you see the Kikuka Sho?”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wahhh~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I've gone and made a masterpiece~! Everyone loved it so much...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The next one's coming up soon, though!
The final leg of the Autumn Senior Triple Crown, the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Let's make it a grand finale that satisfies both new and long-time readers! And then—)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Next is...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Next is—...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――... After that one?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Japan Cup.
Kiseki, who had promised to work on a strategy plan, had stopped moving her hands.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No!
I've got energy to spare!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Would it be more beautiful
if it just ended here?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah..., no!
That's not what I meant, um—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I'm going to go cool my head!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I chase after Kiseki who had run off.
...However, her figure quickly grew small and vanished from sight.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa...!
...Gh... why, like that—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, a message from Trainer...! 
I really am making them worry...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"‘Don't worry!’
‘I'll have a new strategy proposal ready by tomorrow!’"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to practice what we preach!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —There is only one path, and...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Fatigue from the Japan Cup seems to have caught up! The fan-favorite Kiseki has sunk to 5th place!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"And this is what happens after beating Ai-chan?"
"What a disappointment."
"She shouldn't have entered in the first place."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A strategy switch from Front Runner to Late Closer!
Yet Kiseki falls just one step short!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh, she lost again?"
"Where'd all that fire from the Japan Cup go?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"It would've been a masterpiece
if it had just ended at the Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...gh..., haah... haah...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All I can come up with are such boring ideas...!
There's still so much more I could draw, isn't there...?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki wins the Japan Cup.
She finally reaches the protagonist she has always admired—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...To have made that dream come true...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghhh, urghhh...!
Grrrrhhh...!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Every manga has its time to end.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's when a happy or bad end comes...
When you reach an "ending."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If one ignores the ending, misses the moment to step down,
and pointlessly stretches out a creation...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Even the greatest masterpiece can turn into a fuzzy disappointment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day, Kiseki reported having a fever, so training was canceled for the day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rising from my chair, I locked the room.
My destination—the place that possessed us.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ââ!! Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse.
Kiseki stood alone where the Japan Cup
had just recently been held.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry!
I lied to you—
choice_data_list: If you wanted to draw manga, you could've just told me

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Hypothetically speaking...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if everything that follows feels superfluous,
would you still read this manga?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "You haven't forgotten either, have you? The sight of that victory at the Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A finale greater than that...
I don't think there's any left in me anymore.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That day when I managed to defeat
my greatest rival, my nemesis Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "That'll definitely be the highlight of my life. The kind of awesome memory I'll still look back on even when I'm an old grandma."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I feel that if the curtain falls right here, it would make for the most beautiful ending."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...If it ends while everyone's still longing for more, it'll become a masterpiece that stays in their hearts forever.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of the work,
it's best if I retire now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stillness encloses the space.
A chill of loneliness cuts across my body.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ……There is no "next time" anymore.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's better... not to have it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki is a creator to the core.
So much so that she makes even her own life choices strictly for the sake of her work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her reasoning made complete sense.
If that was what she wanted, I had no objections.
Just as I was about to say that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I step closer to Kiseki
and snatch away the tablet she had hidden behind her back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I met Kiseki at Tokyo Racecourse today,
she was trying to draw something—on her tablet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And just as I thought, displayed there was an unfinished manga.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some panels are blacked out, and others
end half-finished.
Even so—
choice_data_list: You still have your manga, don't you...!
You still have your manga, don't you...?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...All of them are complete trash...!
None of it looks remotely interesting...!!
choice_data_list: Even so, you haven't given up on drawing!
Even so, you haven't given up on drawing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Kiseki is a creator to the core.
So much so that she's willing to dedicate her life to making things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if I accepted her proposal,
and she were to graduate from the academy just like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even as I live a normal life—eating breakfast, having tea with friends, and riding the train back home—whenever I happen to watch a movie, read a comic, or catch the news, suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is sure to think about it.
About what she herself can create.
choice_data_list: You are the protagonist—and the creator.
You are the protagonist—and the creator.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...If we stretch it out, we might end up with a final chapter that feels like a cancellation, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: A conclusion that was once perfect might end up completely ruined, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...You really are something else...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I completely agree!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At that moment, a massive clap of thunder roared... drowning out the sound of the rain.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If we can create something even more exciting than this perfect ending, it'll undoubtedly be the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking about being able to create something like that
sends shivers down my spine! I wouldn't need anything else!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Still...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't move forward unless I'm prepared to destroy that.
Including all the reputation I've built up until now."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if I lose and lose, never win a single time,
and end up facing a miserable conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Will you stay with me through my story?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if I get covered in mud,
will you stay by my side without letting go of this hand?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: No matter how this ends, you—!
choice_data_list: Your story is my story too.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I knew it, you're the one for me.
...It has to be with you."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Please be listed in the back-of-the-book credits with me.
As my... editor-in-charge."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's create it, Trainer.
Even if we're burned down to ashes in the end.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: As long as we have the drive to push forward, we can share our work with the world...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No matter how battered and exhausted I get, as long as I reach a masterpiece, I don't care!
Because—I want to draw!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I want to create something exciting...!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, class is finally over!
Kiseki, let's grab lunch...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ...I'll go buy some sandwiches later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, too, Kiseki is glued to her tablet,
drawing up a new strategic proposal.
choice_data_list: When do you think the next storyboard will be ready?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Just a little more...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Are we not going to make it in time!?
How much buffer time do we have left!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I open my planner and count down the days
until the race registration deadline.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Kiseki aims for the next milestone,
it's the Arima Kinen, which would complete the Autumn Senior Triple Crown.
choice_data_list: If you're running in the Arima Kinen, the deadline is this weekend.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Understood!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Constantly pushing Kiseki to make sure she meets her deadlines...
Spending my days like that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Breaking news just came in.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I, Almond Eye, will be running
in a race in Dubai next year!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Once I become number one in the world there—
I'll get my revenge on Kiseki-chan!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Eeeehk!?
Ai-chan is going to the world... !?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, what do we do...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Things have gotten interesting, haven't they...!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's aim to be number one in the world
at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!
And then we'll accept Ai-chan's rematch!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa! Hearing you say it out loud makes it even crazier!
This hype is unreal!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Trainer,
can I hold a press conference too?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I just came up with an insanely hype sequence of events!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I, Kiseki, will be running in this year's grand finale,
the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Once I become Japan's strongest there,
I plan to head onto the world stage!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So please, by all means, come and try to stop me!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Any horse girl who thinks I'm not the strongest...
will just have to use her own legs to pin me down."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooo!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having learned how to effectively hype up the crowd, Kiseki
puts on quite the show of bravado in front of the press.
choice_data_list: (…Still, this is interesting in its own way)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as the protagonist never stops moving forward,
her story will continue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —As long as we never stop moving forward, forever.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...The strongest is... 
...I'm the one who's...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Yes.
I will defeat them, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ......Because this isn't over yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as there are those who keep challenging,
as long as there are those who keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The "story" never ends.
